publicationRules: Pair every status color with readable text.
Suppress positional motion for reduced-motion preferences and keyboard interaction.
Treat live publication and recording states from the API as authoritative.

narrative.overview: Graphite surfaces, readable type, and lime actions. The supplied gaming video is the dashboard's single focal image; operational pages remain compact and task-focused.
dos: Preserve semantic tokens, visible focus, readable labels, and responsive source rows.
Keep supplied video separate from uploaded source media and preserve its provenance.
donts: Do not render retained Efferd demos as additional dashboards or heroes.
Do not introduce fabricated metrics or enable future processing through preview controls.
Do not animate routine polling updates or make animation a prerequisite for an action.
